generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as CAT-1 reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement (KPPP) portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

As per Karnataka State Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01-01-2007 and Government letter No PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards construction labour welfare fund.

The Item rates quoted shall include cost of Royalty charges on construction materials and other taxes as per the rates provided in prevailing Government Orders at the time of execution and including cost and conveyance of all materials, curing, loading and Unloading with all lifts, labour, Hire charges of machinery and equipments etc, complete and all other incidental charges.

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works  and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
Constitutional or Legal Status of tenderer.
Qualification and experience of key Technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the Tenderer & those that are proposed to be deployed on this work if awarded.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing e-Procurement (KPPP) Portal.
All materials required for this work, shall be produced by the tenderer himself and should be got tested by the quality control authorities, at his own cost before using for the work.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.

The construction materials (minerals metal, sand and murrum) shall be bought from the authorized quarries along with the mineral dispatch permit or else 5 times the royalty will be deducted as penalty as per the Directions on the Director, Mines and Geology Department Bangalore proceedings dated 25.03.2013.
Each Tenderer shall furnish work execution programme bar chart for a working period of 12 months.
EMD Rs 20,970/- should be paid in favor of Executive Engineer PWD Division Sirsi through e-payment.
Work Completion period 12 months (Including Monsoon)
The employer reserves the rights to reject one or all Tenders without assigning any reasons.
The tenderers are requested to abide instructions and conditions contained in the Standard Bid Documents -KW-2 and further orders thereon.
Financial Year will be reckoned as the period between first day of April and Thirty First day of March of succeeding year (both days inclusive).
GST-18% shall be paid to the tender amount separately
Eligibility of Contractor is Class-IV & Above

Tenderers shall obtain the Work Done Certificate in the prescribed format from the Competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer (District Level Officer) and Scan the original certificates and attach the scanned file to the tenders. The original Certificate shall be produced before opening of Financial Bid for physical verification.

To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. (2021-22 to 2025-26) achieved in at least One financial year a minimum financial turnover (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) of Rs 20.97 Lakhs

To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26, Satisfactorily completed as prime contractor, at least any construction work to an extent of 25% of the cost of the work value not less than Rs.5.24 Lakhs
The increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time
Star Rates are not applicable

itemList.description: Maintenance of Drains - The maintenance of drains include erosion, repair, clearing, cleaning,  reshaping,  regrading,  deepening  of  side  drains as well as catch water drains as per technical specification Clause 1908. Restoration of rain cuts with soil, moorum, gravel or a mixture of these, clearing the loose soil, benching for 300 mm width, laying  fresh  material  in  layers  not  exceeding  250  mm  and compacting with plate compactor or power rammers to restore the original alignment, levels and slopes. Patching of Potholes - Patching of Shallow Potholes using SDBC Gr II 25 mm thick - Patching  of  shallow  potholes  on  asphalt  surfaces  by  using Semi Dense Bituminous Concrete 25mm thickness.
